about: Nodes of the meteorology lineage graph, type "dataset": where the output can be fetched. Ids are stable (incident.entities@ may adopt them); meaning is in the edges (meteorology/edges/), not here.

nodes.name: ECMWF open data
nodes.summary: A subset of the IFS and AIFS real-time forecasts as GRIB2 files, free, no key.

nodes.name: ERA5 (Copernicus Climate Change Service)
nodes.summary: ECMWF's reanalysis of the global weather since 1940, produced for the EU's Copernicus programme: the training set of most machine-learned models.

nodes.name: NOAA NOMADS (NCEP model output)
nodes.summary: GFS, GEFS and other NCEP model output as GRIB2 over HTTPS, with a filter that cuts a region and variables.

nodes.name: NOAA Aviation Weather Center data API
nodes.summary: METAR and TAF for any aerodrome as JSON, no key: how our data room reads Lisbon airport.

nodes.name: DWD open data server
nodes.summary: ICON model fields, radar, stations and warnings as files over HTTPS, no key.

nodes.name: MET Norway weather API (api.met.no)
nodes.summary: Locationforecast and other products as JSON for any point on Earth, no key, an identifying User-Agent required.

nodes.name: Open-Meteo
nodes.summary: One HTTP API in front of many national models (ECMWF, GFS, ICON, ARPEGE/AROME, UKMO and more), no key for non-commercial use.

nodes.name: EUMETSAT Data Store and EUMETView
nodes.summary: EUMETSAT's products: imagery as WMS/WMTS map layers and the data as files through an API.

nodes.name: Copernicus Emergency Management Service
nodes.summary: The EU's rapid mapping of disasters (flood extents from satellites) and the European flood awareness system.

nodes.name: Copernicus Marine Service
nodes.summary: Ocean analyses and forecasts (waves, sea level, currents) for European seas, including the Iberia-Biscay-Ireland region.

nodes.name: Météo-France open data
nodes.summary: Météo-France's models (ARPEGE, AROME), observations and radar as open data on meteo.data.gouv.fr.

nodes.name: IPMA open data (api.ipma.pt)
nodes.summary: IPMA's warnings, forecasts and station observations as JSON, no key. Mapped by incident.ipma@ under sources/ipma/.

nodes.name: MeteoAlarm feeds
nodes.summary: Every member's warnings as Atom and CAP. Mapped by incident.sources@ under sources/meteoalarm/.

nodes.name: Tide predictions (Instituto Hidrográfico)
nodes.summary: The official tide tables for Portuguese ports. A storm surge on a high spring tide is how Lisbon's riverside floods: the tide is astronomy, the surge is weather.
